name: Layout Import
description: Turn pages of a WordPress site laid out with [av_…] shortcodes of the old theme's layout builder into native blocks of the block editor: sections, columns, texts, headings, images, galleries, buttons, tables and more. From the WordPress export, or from pages already imported where the shortcodes stayed as text. Each page gets a new revision, undone from Revisions.
author: Cleitext
